chose: A scene of the weekly call too long for its captioned frame is paged by code: its title on every page, its lists (board rows, pull requests, options, later asks, next steps) and parts carried on in order, each page its own scene (done-3, done-3-2, ...), said over on its first page and held silently for its words' reading time after. Nothing is cut, counted away or sent back to be shortened; call-check refuses only a single part taller than a whole frame. The template's look is unchanged. One model (call-fit.ts) decides the pages for the stage, the cut list and call-check alike.
options: page a long scene into several scenes, nothing cut
show what fits and count the rest ("and 16 more")
refuse any week whose scenes run past the frame, and have the routine trim it
shrink the type until it fits
gray: How a long batch or ask is shown is the owner's to see on screen. Counting the rest was this PR's first shape, and the owner turned it down on 2026-11-14 (relayed by the coordinator of #2918): no editorial cuts, the call has a lot to catch up. Splitting at the page rather than shrinking keeps the template's look, which is the owner's.
undo: Make callScenes return the scenes whole (drop pagedScenes in call.ts) and have the stage draw each list in full; that brings back the overflow this fixes, so pair it with another bound.
